La main détachée visible sur le sol n'est pas ajoutée à cette pose idle, qui ne représente pas toutes les phases de l'affrontement. One static drawing. Native generated pixels unchanged; no resize, crop, alpha painting or other pixel processing. Very low alpha noise can extend beyond readable bounds.
selected.usageRestriction: Preserve existing role and rules; this image adds no new attacks or movement.
selected.prompt: Correct the HEAD IDENTITY of the sprite in image 3 using the actual Water Guardian from Silent Hill: Book of Memories in images 1 and 2. Image 1 is the native bestiary; image 2 is native PS Vita gameplay. The previous sprite wrongly made a long curved backward hooked crest like an Alien monster. Remove that unsupported giant hooked crescent entirely. The source head is a much shorter broad heavy rounded/wedge-shaped blue-grey crown smoothly merging into the bloated torso, with a shallow central ridge, deep furrows and a relatively small hungry opening in the front. Keep the creature's exact monolithic body: two heavy long arms with claw hands, ridged neck/trunk, swollen rounded closed lower base and no legs. Match the short compact head outline in image 1 rather than improvising an alien, dragon or fish; no dorsal horn, no tail, no extra fins, no humanoid face or eyes. Retain a strict lateral whole-body side profile facing RIGHT, with both arms complete and staggered, source bluish-green purple wet material. One character only. True transparent alpha outside the silhouette including all inner gaps, no atmospheric halo, no scenery, no UI. Whole crown, both hands and entire closed base fit with 8 percent clear transparent padding. One static sprite, no animation.

selected.prompt: Edit IMAGE 1 only to rotate this exact Earth Guardian from Book of Memories into a STRICT RIGHT-FACING 90-DEGREE SIDE PROFILE. The current view is still three-quarter front. Image 2 is the native-game identity reference. The pointed stone upper jaw and open mouth must project entirely toward screen RIGHT; show the side wall of the rocky head, not the broad front mouth cavity. Both floating stone arms should align front/back in the side view, with the near fist in front of the head toward screen right and the far fist partially behind. Preserve the complete heavy irregular rock head, its natural closed pointed bottom and exactly two segmented floating stone arms with their complete fists. No torso or legs. Keep source color, materials and shape, no new ornaments or parts. One clean complete static sprite with true transparent alpha and at least 8 percent clear margin. No scenery, no ground, no aura, no text. Do not change into a standing humanoid golem.
